body:
We dropped at around 8 and started walking around the college campus. We started to come up and took part in the usual tripping activities (adventuring, raving, etc.).
At around 1 we got the sudden urge to smoke my hookah (The White Rabbit). Filled with joy we grabbed the box and a water bottle and headed out to the swinging tables with our eyes filled with glee and our hearts with joy. Of course, the ice we brought was far too large to fit in the hookah, so we proceeded to break it up by biting it with our molars -- only after it had been on the ground of course. The bowl was packed and everything was set up when we realized the flaw in our plan; we forgot to bring tin foil. We tried to use the foil that the coals were wrapped in (which turned out to not be foil at all).  This failed miserably. So sadly, we packed everything up and went back to the dorms to hunt for tin foil. That whole episode took the whole of 10 minutes (though it felt like 45). With tin foil in hand we raced back outside to hunt for a place to smoke when we laid eyes on Primera Casa - the oldest building on the college campus. We ascended the steps and reassembled the hookah (this time with everything we needed). It was glorious.
Smoking hookah while on acid is probably on my top 10 list of favorite things to do. Not only was is relaxing, but to watch the smoke clouds fractal was truly beautiful. This is a highly recommended activity, though I would recommend having a sober body with you so that you don't forget your hookah essentials.
